text:
maya (Support): customer reports free-trial credits show as "Applied" in the admin console but their quota/ledger balance didn't change. happened ~30m ago.
jamie (Eng Oncall): can you paste the org id and the support ticket id?
maya (Support): org=org_8f2b, ticket=SUP-11234. I repro locally on staging by clicking grant -> shows toast success but API returns 202 then nothing.
miguel (DevEx): tagging @jamie — pushed a small change last week around grant idempotency; could be related.
backoffice-bot: grant request queued - request_id=gr_0192b, user=org_8f2b, amount=1000 credits, promo=TRIAL2026
jamie (Eng Oncall): checking logs for request_id=gr_0192b...
jamie (Eng Oncall): found an entry: 2026-03-17T14:12:45Z grant_handler: accepted request_id=gr_0192b, idempotency_key=ik_5a7c, state=applied_to_ui
jamie (Eng Oncall): but no ledger write record. backend returned 202 to UI after enqueuing job.
maya (Support): user says they clicked once only, no duplicate clicks.
olivia (Billing): if ledger wasn't written, customer's usable credits won't update — needs manual ledger entry as interim.
kate (SRE): is the worker processing the grant queue healthy? I see consumer restarts around that time.
jamie (Eng Oncall): consumer=backoffice-grants-processor pod/grants-processor-3 had an OOM at 14:11:39 and restarted. the job may have been requeued but idempotency semantics dropped the final commit.
miguel (DevEx): oh — our idempotency keys are hashed and truncated in the worker; a truncated collision could cause the job to be treated as duplicate and a noop. working theory.
jamie (Eng Oncall): repro steps I'm running locally: run grants-processor, send grant API with idempotency ik_5a7c, kill processor mid-job (SIGTERM), let restart, observe UI toast success, ledger missing.
maya (Support): can we do a manual workaround for SUP-11234? customer needs credits today.
olivia (Billing): yes create manual ledger entry with reason 'support emergency manual grant' and link to support ticket. i'll approve.
jamie (Eng Oncall): temp mitigation: increment idempotency key length in processor and add stronger pre-commit journal so restarts don't lose finalize step. will open PR.
miguel (DevEx): adding extra telemetry around job lifecycle too (queued -> started -> commit). that will help triage.
kate (SRE): schedule a short maintenance window to roll the grants-processor pods with new image once PR is validated. prefer low-traffic window.
maya (Support): thanks folks. I'll notify customer of manual credit and ETA for fix. cc @olivia for billing audit. :white_check_mark:
jamie (Eng Oncall): created ENG-4578 with notes and draft fix, linking SUP-11234 and the logs. PR in draft: https://git.redwood/eng/backoffice/pulls/182
miguel (DevEx): quick snippet of repro command for engineers:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/grant 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>' 
 -d '{"org_id":"org_8f2b","amount":1000,"idempotency_key":"ik_5a7c"}'
# then simulate worker SIGTERM during processing
```
jamie (Eng Oncall): follow-up: we'll patch with a journaled two-phase commit in the processor and increase idempotency key retention. target hotfix deploy in 48 hours.
olivia (Billing): will flag the manual ledger entry for audit and notify finance.
maya (Support): closing loop with customer now. thanks all :pray:
